title: UFO Crashes & Evidence / Battling Demonic Entities
byline: Coast to Coast AM Staff - October 16, 2026
excerpt: Ryan S. Wood, a specialist in UFO crash retrievals shared insights from decades of research. Followed by psychic medium June Lundgren on negative or demonic entities, and how they attach themselves to people.
content:
In the first half, Ryan S. Wood, a specialist in UFO crash retrievals and government secrecy, shared insights from decades of research, building on the legacy of his late father, aerospace engineer Robert M. Wood. He highlighted the 1941 Cape Girardeau UFO crash in Missouri as one of his most thoroughly investigated incidents, involving remote viewing and archival research. Wood also discussed theories on why UFOs crash, including electromagnetic interference, missiles, scalar waves, radar, or negative lightning bolts. On the technological front, he noted that reverse engineering of crashed UFOs, such as the Roswell incident, may have contributed to breakthroughs in integrated circuits, lasers, and fiber optics.

Discussing current government disclosures, Wood expressed skepticism: "It's drip, drip, drip. They're never really going to show you the juicy stuff... the hardware, the bodies—that would allow scientific inquiry and firmly establish an extraterrestrial reality." He explained the risks of full disclosure, including economic and sociopolitical upheaval. Highlighting modern efforts, he mentioned his search engine at UFOdex.com, a vast, AI-powered archive with over a million pages of rare UFO-related documents.

He outlined his late father's scientific approach, categorizing UFO phenomena in three buckets: almost certain, probable, and speculative. In the almost certain category, Wood placed the UFO crash retrievals. Ryan also paid tribute to Stanton Friedman, describing him as a groundbreaking nuclear physicist who engaged young audiences with intellectual UFO discussions. Friedman worked for his father at McDonnell Douglas on gravity control and manipulation and on "trying to understand propulsion systems of UFOs," he said, adding that he and Friedman later spent time together trying to authenticate the "Majestic 12" documents.

------------

In the latter half, psychic medium and author June Lundgren discussed the hierarchy of negative or demonic entities, and the signs of attachments and possesion. After a near-death experience in 1986, she claims to have met the archangel Michael, who informed her that she was a "demon slayer," and that her soul belonged to the archangel Ariel. Lundgren distinguishes between two types of negative entities: human souls that remain trapped after death and pure dark beings unable to take physical form. These entities often attach themselves to individuals, causing chaos and suffering, she explained, adding that their selection process is like a "job interview," where they assess a person's vulnerabilities, including faith, mental health, and lifestyle choices (according to Lundgren, occult activities increase susceptibility).

She believes the demons' ultimate goal is revenge for being banished from the light realm after a cosmic war. They create "dark portals" to enter the human world and can possess people or objects. Possession, she said, can be a subtle process where "a lot of times they kind of sneak in the back door," and victims may experience alienation, declining health, and hearing "voices nobody else can hear—not good voices."

Interestingly, she shared an encounter with a demon she called Herb, who sought redemption and cooperation and acted as a bridge between dark and light realms. Regarding protection, she emphasized faith and the power of prayer. "In order to do an exorcism, you have to have absolute faith in God... If you have any doubts whatsoever, it's never going to work." She combats these entities in a separate realm of existence, where Ariel comes to the forefront. Lundgren said her eyes turn white, and "thought becomes reality, and it's the intention behind the thought that gives us the power for good."
